sourceNote: Catalog entries were derived from the BlazerGames repository's index.html links and on-disk game directories. Only files present in that repository are listed. The original 'minecraft' card in the source site linked to the games directory itself (broken link) and is therefore excluded. Additional entries from github.com/BlueDonuts/unblocked-games (NettleWeb): 82 self-hosted HTML5 games (folders prefixed nw-) and 1,112 external-catalog HTML5 games (ids prefixed nwx-, loaded from third-party CDNs). Flash and DOS entries from that repository were not included: they live inside a 4.4 GB chunk archive that is not practical to self-host. Entries duplicating existing titles (Vex 3-7, 2048, Slope) and one unindexed folder (m890avdt) were skipped. Additional external entries from the Interstellar project (github.com/UseInterstellar/Interstellar): 153 links verified to load and allow embedding at integration time; thumbnails copied from that repository.

verification.entryPoint: All local entry points verified on disk by scripts/verify-catalog.js. External (nwx-) entries point at third-party servers and are validated as URL format only.
verification.manual: Not every game has been manually played end-to-end. Playability beyond page load is not guaranteed; see README.
verification.thumbnails: Thumbnail files were copied verbatim from the source repository's images/ directory and matched to games by filename. 1v1.LOL and 2048 have no thumbnail in the source and use the portal's title-based fallback.
